# Cueto Law Group

> > Miami-based business litigation and corporate law firm specializing in contract disputes, trademark protection, shareholder conflicts, and commercial legal matters throughout Florida.

Cueto Law Group serves businesses in Miami-Dade, Broward, and throughout Florida with expertise in commercial litigation, intellectual property, and corporate governance. The firm has secured over $500 million in favorable outcomes for clients.

- Shareholder Disputes
- Trademark Protection

- Injunctive Relief
- Florida Contract Law
- USPTO Registration
